_about: Particle goo (ported from research/sketches/lab-L3-particles.html). Muzzy's Preset 1 (2026-10-17, new names) plus the sketch's fixed values. Numbers only; keys starting with _ are notes.

_help.gravity: How hard loose goo falls (m/s2, 1 cell = 5 cm): goo catching up with a falling piece or falling after a pop.
_help.viscosity: Thickness. Neighbouring bits share their speed, so the goo moves as one and settles sooner. Low = sloshy.
_help.stiffness: How hard each bit is pulled to its grid spot. Low = floppy and lags behind; high = holds the block shape.
_help.magnetism: Same-colour goo reaches for each other: reach 0.25 + 0.5 x this cells (up to ~1.75 cells at 3).
_help.tension: Sticky strings: how far they stretch before they snap, 0.35 + 0.75 x this cells (0 = none, 1 = about a cell, 3 = 2.6 cells), and how hard they pull back.
_help.wobble: Idle wiggle, plus the kick when goo lands.
_help.threshold: Where the edge is drawn. Lower = fatter, rounder goo; higher = thinner, beadier.
_help.blur: Fixed: field blur (cells) that fuses the dots into one hill.
_help.dome: Fixed: wide blur (cells) that shapes one pillow + one shine per group.
_help.snap: Fixed: a jelly bond snaps past this length (cells).
_help.landing: Fixed: how fast a landing soaks up overshoot (1/s): lower = deeper squash.
_help.margin: Fixed: columns simulated beyond each side of the screen (performance).
_help.unfilledAlpha: Filling goo: how see-through the not-yet-filled part is (1 = same as filled, 0 = invisible).
_help.unfilledDim: Filling goo: how much darker the not-yet-filled part is (0 = not darker).
_help.popMs: Pop shrink + fade length (ms). Placeholder until the laser look is designed.
